rows.corpus_definition: To move slowly from side to side.
rows.example_en: The trees began to sway in the breeze.

rows.corpus_definition: To get larger or rounder than usual.
rows.example_en: My hand began to swell after the sting.

rows.corpus_definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone else
rows.example_en: She offered her sympathy to the grieving family.

rows.corpus_definition: The feeling of being sorry for someone who is in pain.
rows.example_en: I have great sympathy for those who lost their homes.

rows.corpus_definition: To take control of something from someone else.
rows.example_en: She will take over the business.

rows.corpus_definition: Start a new hobby or activity.
rows.example_en: I want to take up tennis this summer.

rows.corpus_definition: Having a natural ability to do something well.
rows.example_en: She is a very talented young painter.

rows.corpus_definition: Not dangerous or wild, and used to living with humans.
rows.example_en: The horse was very tame and ate from my hand.

rows.corpus_definition: To say unkind things to someone to make them angry.
rows.example_en: Do not tease your younger brother for crying.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who works at a bank helping customers with money.
rows.example_en: I spoke to the teller to deposit my cash.

rows.corpus_definition: A tendency to become angry very easily.
rows.example_en: He has a very short temper.
